title: Decorative Sniffer Eggs
description: Decorate with Sniffer Egg blocks without fear of hatching!
body: **Decorative Sniffer Eggs** is a small quality of life mod by **Craisin** and **Laynce**. It is a continuation of Laynce's Decorative Sniffer Egg mod, that has been redesigned, and brought to newer versions of the game! Now it is significantly more humane :D When a Sniffer Egg hatches, it now leaves behind a Sniffer Egg Shell. These shells are able to be crafted into a Hollow Sniffer Egg, a decorative version of the egg that will not hatch. Unlike the vanilla Sniffer Egg, the Hollow Sniffer Egg can also be placed directionally, making it easier to use in builds. *** [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/452/988/bh_id_promo.png)](https://www.bisecthosting.com/craisincraft)   I’ve spent thousands of hours on my mods.
